description: Add a creator as a manual match to a campaign. Idempotent on (campaign, profileId). Stores the platform, handle, name, picture, and follower count of the catalog profile and keeps only profileId and fitScore from the input; a profileId with no catalog profile returns not_found. While a send request is open, once the campaign is sent, or while it is archived, it returns a tool error naming the reason. Needs a credential.

fitScore.description: Fit score from search_creators, 0 to 1, or null when unknown

followerCount.description: Follower count at snapshot time, at least 1000

platform.description: ig for Instagram or tt for TikTok

profileImageUrl.description: Portrait URL from search_creators, or null

username.description: Creator handle from search_creators, or null

name: add_campaign_match
title: Add campaign match
